Project Journey

Project Journey

We follow a systematic approach to transform your ideas into working technical solutions.

  1. 1
    Architecture & Consultation

    Analysis & Engineering

    • Brainstorming session: Understanding project requirements, required functions, and technical constraints.
    • Technical feasibility study: Selecting the most suitable components (Hardware) and optimal programming languages (Software) to ensure highest performance at lowest cost.
  2. 2
    Design Digital

    Digital Design & Modeling

    • Mechanical design: Building structures and parts using SolidWorks, considering strength and weight.
    • Electronic design: Drawing electrical circuits (PCB Design) and selecting sensors and controllers.
    • User interface design: (UX/UI) If the project includes screens or control applications.
  3. 3
    Development Software

    Software Development

    • Embedded programming: (Embedded Systems) Writing code for controllers (Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi).
    • Algorithm programming: Integrating artificial intelligence or data processing if the project requires it.
    • Control application development: Connecting the project to mobile apps or computer programs.
  4. 4
    Assembly & Manufacturing

    Manufacturing & Assembly

    • Digital manufacturing: Printing parts using 3D technology or laser cutting.
    • Engineering assembly: Installing mechanical parts, soldering circuits, and assembling the prototype.
  5. 5
    Control Quality & Testing

    Testing & Quality Control

    • Stress testing: Ensuring the project withstands different working conditions.
    • System calibration: Adjusting sensors and software to achieve the required accuracy.
